# Hawaii Fresh Juice

> Authentic Omani freshness in every bottle.

## About

Hawaii Fresh Juice is a certified Omani juice brand founded in March 2024 by Yasir Arafath. We offer 100% natural, farm-to-bottle fruit juices sourced from carefully selected fruits at local Omani markets. Our mission is to make fresh, high-quality fruit juices accessible and affordable for everyone.

We are based in Al Wadi Al Kabir, Muscat, Sultanate of Oman, and we take pride in delivering carefully crafted juices — honest, fresh, and made for everyday enjoyment.

## Products

All products are 100% organic, contain no artificial preservatives, and come in 200mL bottles priced at 0.200 OMR.

### Ginger Orange (Signature)
A bright, golden crush of premium sun-ripened oranges with a hint of local ginger. Rich in Vitamin C with immune support and anti-inflammatory benefits.
- Calories: 102.45 per 200mL
- Ingredients: Fresh Orange Fruit, Organic Ginger, Natural Sweetener, Natural Citric Acid
- URL: https://hawaiioman.com/products/ginger-orange

### Ball Grape (Seasonal)
Deep, rich, and naturally sweet grapes harvested from the high-altitude crisp terraces.
- Calories: 268.45 per 200mL
- Ingredients: Fresh Grape Fruit, Natural Citric Acid, Natural Sweetener, Natural Preservatives
- URL: https://hawaiioman.com/products/ball-grape

### Pieces Mango (Best Seller)
Lusciously sweet and thick mango puree grown organically in tropical regions.
- Calories: 109.74 per 200mL
- Ingredients: Fresh Mango Fruit, Natural Sweetener, Natural Preservatives, Natural Citric Acid
- URL: https://hawaiioman.com/products/pieces-mango

### Natural Lemon (New)
A refreshing blend of zesty lemons, cooling mint, and a touch of sweetness.
- Calories: 102.43 per 200mL
- Ingredients: Fresh Lemon, Refreshing Mint, Natural Sweetener, Natural Preservatives
- URL: https://hawaiioman.com/products/natural-lemon

### Coming Soon
- Ice Bounty: A rich, creamy blend of chocolate and milk infused with warm aromatic spices.
- Pieces Pineapple: Pure, golden pineapple chunks pressed into a sweet, vibrant nectar of the sun.

## FAQ

**Q: What is Hawaii Fresh Juice?**
A: A certified Omani juice brand founded March 2024 by Yasir Arafath, making 100% natural farm-to-bottle fruit juices in Al Wadi Al Kabir, Muscat, Oman.

**Q: Are the juices 100% natural?**
A: Yes. 100% organic, no artificial preservatives or additives, made farm-to-bottle from fresh fruit.

**Q: What flavors are available?**
A: Ginger Orange (signature), Ball Grape (seasonal), Pieces Mango (best seller), Natural Lemon (new). Coming soon: Ice Bounty, Pieces Pineapple.

**Q: How much does it cost?**
A: 0.200 OMR per 200 mL bottle.

**Q: Where can I buy it in Oman?**
A: At the juice bar in Al Wadi Al Kabir, Muscat, and via select retailers, groceries and schools across Oman. Open Saturday–Thursday, 8:00 AM–6:00 PM.

**Q: Who does Hawaii Fresh Juice supply?**
A: Partners include Oman Ministry of Defence, Al Khuwair University, Al Aba Catering Services, Rozanna Restaurant Group, Royal Hospital Shopping Centre, Sri Lankan Schools Oman, Welcome Restaurant Group, Famous Bakery, Fawaris Bakery, plus retail shops, groceries and schools.
